About

Modern finance profile with a technology edge.

I am building a career centered on finance and investment, supported by risk thinking, business discipline, and a strong interest in how technology and AI can improve analysis, efficiency, and decision quality.

I am currently pursuing a Bachelor of Mathematics (Co-op, Honours) in Financial Analysis & Risk Management at the University of Waterloo, where I have developed a strong foundation in financial markets, risk management, optimization, statistics, and analytical reasoning.

My professional experience reflects a clear upward trajectory. I strengthened my leadership and operational control through managing high-volume retail operations at CoCo Bubble Tea, deepened my finance and accounting execution through TaxAssist Accountants, and am advancing into business transformation and enterprise risk management through my role with Toyota Credit Canada Inc. (Toyota Financial Services Canada).

Long term, I want to continue growing into opportunities related to finance, investment, wealth, risk, and strategic business analysis. I am especially drawn to work that combines disciplined thinking, measurable impact, and modern technological capability.
